name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
summary: An open spec from OpenAI and Stripe for agent-led checkout: the agent creates and updates a checkout session at the merchant, then pays with a delegated, scoped payment token, while the merchant stays merchant of record. ChatGPT was the first platform to implement it.
facts: 2026-04-17 (adds carts, feed API, orders, MCP binding)
Delegated payment tokens; Stripe Shared Payment Token first
goodFor: Checkout without exposing card numbers to the agent
watchOut: Beta with breaking changes between dated versions
Competes with UCP and AP2 for the same role
